relations.myth: Legba opens the gate for the other lwa
relations.note: Legba enables ritual communication with the collective and is invoked before its members arrive.
Agwe's acceptance or refusal of an offshore offering is interpreted within the wider spirit community.

relations.myth: Papa Lébat opens access to Louisiana spirits
relations.note: Later recollections portray him as the doorkeeper mediating ritual access to other Louisiana spirits.
